DILG Republic Of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City OPINION NO FEB 2 ATTY. ARLO ALEXANDER CAWLEY Dauis, Bohol Dear Atty. Cawley: This has reference to your electronic mail requesting for this Department's legal opinion and guidance regarding the extent of the coverage of the exemption provided under Section 19 of RA 7279, otherwise known as the Urban Development and Housing Act of 1992. According to the representation, one of the awardees went to the Dauis Municipal Assessor's office to process her housing award from the National Housing Authority (NHA), which included a request for certified true copies of tax declarations, vicinity maps, and tax clearances from the local treasurer's office, all of which were required by the BIR for eCAR processing. You represented that the beneficiary incurred expenses for processing such requests. Thus, the request for legal opinion as to the coverage of the exemption as to the payables in the local Assessor's Office in connection to the process of transferring the NHA title to the name of the beneficiary. At the onset, please be informed that this department is precluded from acting on queries which are cognizable by other agencies of the government. DILG Memorandum Order No. 2010-02 dated 17 September 2010 specifically provides: "xxx all concerned are hereby advised that the Department shall not an act on queries of the following kinds, to wit: 4. Those that are cognizable bv other aqencies of the qovernment. Accordingly, this Department is precluded from acting on the first query because it is clearly cognizable by National Housing Authority (NHA) as the matter falls within the competency and expertise of the said office. Notwithstanding, for purposes of academic discussion, Section 191 of RA 7279 and Section 42 of BIR Revenue Regulation No. 9-93 (March 4, 1993) clearly stated that 1 SEC. 19. Incentives for the National Housing Authority. — The National Housing Authority, being the primary government agency in charge Of providing housing for the underprivileged and homeless, shall be exempted from the payment Of all fees and charges Of any kind, whether local or national, such as income and real estate taxes. All documents or contracts executed by and in favor of the National Housing Authority shall also be exempt from the payment of documentary stamp tax and registration fees, induding fees required for the issuance of transfer certificates of titles. SECT-ION 4. Tax Incentives. — A NATIONAL HOUSING AUTHORIIY (NHA) — The NHA being the primary government agency in charge Of providing housing for the underprivileged and homeless citizens shall be exempted from the payroent of all fees "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

only the National Housing Authority is exempt from paying any fees or charges, and that all documents or contracts executed by and in favor of NHA are also exempt from documentary stamp tax and registration fees, including all fees for the issuance of transfer certificates of title. According to the above-mentioned provision, the exemption covers all fees required for the issuance of a transfer certificate of title, including but not limited to unpaid real estate taxes, documentary stamp tax, transfer tax, registration fee, and other incidental and miscellaneous expenses incurred during the registration process. Thus, if fees for certified true copies of tax declarations, vicinity maps, and tax clearances are required for the issuance of a TCT, such fees paid at the local Assessor's Office in connection with the process of transferring the NHA title to the beneficiary's name are considered exempt. The opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in your letter and our appreciation of the same. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P.
